scope: Controlled actual flight-renderer fixture using the generated application bundle for createCombatPresentation; synthetic accepted defeat/surface-impact facts and 128 fixed living actors. No gameplay authority, player controls or production terrain admission. Short diagnostic: native r2 only, High overall graphics with forced High/Ultra effect detail; 30 measured seconds per condition after the bounded authored-cap batching and ring-order cache fixes. This does not replace the longer forced-Ultra comparison. Infinite flat fixture floor with stable surface attachment and radius-aware swept contact. Every phase checks actual Current/r2 activation identity and enabled phases require visible settled remains with no invalid support returns. Every enabled phase begins with 1,024 destruction records and 1,024 surface-impact records, then eight mixed-material defeats plus eight impacts every two seconds. Full gore stays enabled for every measured On frame; no Blood/Remains toggles dilute the workload. Matched phase-local movement, camera, seeds, timeline and thirty-second restoration schedule. Phase screenshots are captured while paused after measurement, before changing the scene. CPU covers event ingestion, actor staging and synchronous draw; GPU uses bounded asynchronous timers around the actual renderer render call, including internal passes, sampled every 15 renders. Probe overhead is included identically in both conditions; no blocking GPU readback. Not a full-app or human gameplay acceptance.
